title: Light Novel 'Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu' Concludes with 10th Volume
content: The official X account for author Nana Mikoshiba announced on Tuesday that the Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu: Sekai Saikyou no Majutsushi de Aru Shounen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ni Nyuugaku suru ( The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ) light novel series will end with its tenth volume, scheduled to be…

title: Hollywood Reporter, Variety: Apple TV in Talks for Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Season 3
content: Entertainment news magazines The Hollywood Reporter and Variety reported on October 29 that Apple TV and Legendary Television are in talks for a possible third season of the Monarch: Legacy of Monsters series, part of Warner Bros. and Legendary Entertainment 's "Monsterverse" franchise .
author: ANN

title: Shueisha Games to Publish Nightmare Operator Action Horror Game
content: Shueisha Games announced on Tuesday that it will publish game developer DDDistortion's third-person action horror shooter NIGHTMARE OPERATOR , which will launch on PC via Steam . The announcement also presented the game's teaser trailer, key art, and voice actress Miyuki Sawashiro as the voice of protagonist Misha.
author: ANN

title: Devils' Crest Anime Confirms Half-Year Run
content: The official website for Devils' Crest , the television anime of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest novel series, confirmed on Tuesday that the anime will run for two consecutive cours (quarters of a year).
author: ANN

title: Millennium Family TV Anime Casts Mutsumi Tamura
content: The staff for the television anime of Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga announced on Tuesday that Mutsumi Tamura voices Arthur, the fifth son and youngest child of the Benfield family.
author: ANN

title: Japanese Animation TV Ranking, October 26-November 1
content: The live-action film Godzilla Minus One aired on NTV on Friday, October 30 at 9:00 p.m. and earned a 7.7% rating. The television ratings above are an estimate of the percentage of the population that watch a given program, based on data from a survey of households in Japan's Kanto region.
author: ANN

title: Kyūgō's Monster in Sheep's Clothing BL Manga Gets Live-Action Film
content: An official X (formerly Twitter ) account opened last month for the live-action film adaptation of Kyūgō 's Monster in Sheep's Clothing ( Hitsuji no Kawa o Kita Kemono ) manga. The film will open in Japan on December 11, after having premiered at the Tokyo International Film Festival (TIFF) on October 28.
author: ANN

title: Web Manga 'Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Publishing company Manga Box announced a television anime adaptation of Izumi and Mitsuya Otosu 's Ore no Shibou Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro wo Shiranai ( My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending ) web manga on Tuesday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured above).

title: After Magic Knight Rayearth, This Clamp Anime Deserves a Reboot Next
content: CLAMP is a Japanese manga group known for dozens of iconic works over the decades in the anime and manga industry. Apart from this beloved action fantasy, CLAMP also created renowned manga such as Cardcaptor Sakura , Blood-C , xxxHOLiC , and many more.
